chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Masqalah ibn Hubayrah ash-Shaybani, while he was his governor over Ardashir Khurrah.

key_terms.أَرْدَشِيرَ خُرَّة: Ardashir Khurrah, a historical region in Iran
key_terms.مَصْقَلَةَ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ: Masqalah ibn Hubayrah, the recipient of the letter

ai.seo_question: Who was Masqalah ibn Hubayrah and what was his role according to Imam Ali's letter?
ai.summary: This heading establishes the administrative context of Imam Ali’s (AS) governance in the eastern provinces, specifically Ardashir Khurrah (modern-day Fars), highlighting the strategic importance of this region during the early Islamic period. It serves as a formal designation for Masqalah ibn Hubayrah, a key tribal leader and governor, underscoring the Imam’s method of delegating authority to trusted companions to maintain order and justice in newly conquered territories.
